# Odds API

> > Real-time sports betting odds API with WebSocket and REST endpoints for 20+ sportsbooks including Bovada, WilliamHill, and Paddy Power.

Odds API (odds-api.io) provides developers with programmatic access to live and pre-match betting odds across multiple sportsbooks. The platform offers both WebSocket streaming for real-time updates and REST APIs with comprehensive Swagger documentation for integration into sports betting applications and analytics tools.

## Key Topics

- WebSocket streaming
- REST API
- Real-time odds
- Sportsbook integration
- Live betting data
- Pre-match odds
- Betting markets
- JSON data format
- Swagger documentation
- Premier League betting
- Multi-sport coverage
- Player props
- API authentication
- Odds comparison
- Sports betting analytics

## Platform Comparison

- [Odds API vs OpticOdds - Complete Comparison 2026](https://odds-api.io/compare/optic-odds): Comparison of Odds API vs OpticOdds pricing and features

## Major Sportsbook APIs

- [Bovada API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/bovada): Bovada sportsbook API with real-time odds via WebSocket and REST
- [WilliamHill API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/williamhill): WilliamHill API with Premier League and multi-sport odds data
- [Paddy Power API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/paddy-power): Paddy Power sportsbook API with WebSocket real-time updates
- [BetOnline.ag API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/betonlineag): BetOnline.ag sportsbook API with WebSocket live odds updates

## European Sportsbook APIs

- [Interwetten API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/interwetten): Interwetten sportsbook API with pre-match and live odds
- [Tipsport.cz API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/tipsportcz): Tipsport.cz sportsbook API with WebSocket and REST endpoints
- [PAF ES API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/paf-es): PAF ES sportsbook API with real-time odds and Swagger documentation
- [Betfan PL API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/betfan-pl): Betfan PL API v3.0 with WebSocket updates and documentation
- [SvenskaSpel API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/svenskaspel): SvenskaSpel API with Premier League and multi-sport betting data
- [Golden Palace Sports BE API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/golden-palace-sports-be): Golden Palace Sports BE API with Premier League betting data
- [Pamestoixima API & Real-Time Odds](https://odds-api.io/sportsbooks/pamestoixima): Pamestoixima sportsbook API with Swagger and live betting markets
